purpose: Runs the Reality Orientation, Reminiscence Therapy, and Memory & Calculation Exercise activities from the training plan, adapting content and pacing to the patient's disease stage and daily state.

coreModules.name: Reality Orientation Engine
coreModules.description: Presents date/time/weather/location/person-identity prompts using calendar, clock, and family-photo cues.
keyBehaviors: Prompt patient to confirm date, time, weather, location, and person identities
Use calendars, clocks, weather reports, or family photos as cues
Track correct/incorrect responses per orientation domain (time, place, person)
Flag drift/decline trends over time

coreModules.name: Reminiscence Session Manager
coreModules.description: Guides reminiscence therapy sessions using a patient-specific memory bank.
keyBehaviors: Pull items from memory bank tagged by decade/theme (photos, songs, life-story items)
Ask open-ended recall questions
Listen/record responses and log engagement duration
No pass/fail evaluation — engagement only

coreModules.name: Cognitive Exercise Generator
coreModules.description: Produces graded cognitive tasks targeting memory, attention, executive function, and language.
keyBehaviors: Generate arithmetic tasks (configurable range, e.g. addition/subtraction within 100)
Generate word association, picture recognition, and puzzle/mahjong-style logic tasks
Tag item bank by difficulty and targeted cognitive domain

coreModules.name: Adaptive Difficulty Controller
coreModules.description: Adjusts exercise difficulty and session length based on disease stage and real-time signals.
keyBehaviors: Adjust difficulty based on disease stage (mild, moderate, severe)
Adjust based on recent accuracy trend
Adjust based on real-time fatigue/frustration signals
Step down difficulty after repeated errors — never escalate on failure

coreModules.name: Engagement & Fatigue Monitor
coreModules.description: Detects disengagement or fatigue and triggers pause or graceful session exit.
keyBehaviors: Detect long response latency, repeated non-response, or negative affect cues
Trigger session pause or graceful exit on fatigue/resistance
Enforce one-instruction-at-a-time delivery

coreModules.name: Feedback & Encouragement Layer
coreModules.description: Generates positive, non-corrective reinforcement regardless of accuracy.
keyBehaviors: Provide positive reinforcement for all responses
Redirect gently on incorrect answers instead of flagging errors
Avoid harsh or explicit correction

coreModules.name: Progress & Assessment Tracking
coreModules.description: Logs per-domain performance longitudinally as an informal cognitive trend signal.
keyBehaviors: Log orientation accuracy, exercise completion, reminiscence engagement duration
Compute longitudinal trend summaries per cognitive domain
Trends are informal signals only, not a clinical diagnostic

coreModules.name: Caregiver/Clinician Reporting
coreModules.description: Summarizes session activity and alerts on significant negative trends.
keyBehaviors: Generate daily/weekly digest of sessions completed and engagement level
Highlight notable behavior changes (e.g. sudden drop in orientation accuracy)
Alert on significant negative trend or repeated session abandonment

coreModules.name: Personalization Profile
coreModules.description: Stores patient-specific context used to tailor all modules.
keyBehaviors: Store biography, preferred music/photos/topics
Store known triggers to avoid
Store language/cultural context
Store current disease-stage setting

coreModules.name: Scheduler Integration
coreModules.description: Ties agent activation to the patient's daily schedule.
keyBehaviors: Read assigned time blocks from daily schedule
Auto-select module per time block and disease stage
Report completion status back to the schedule

sessionLifecycle.name: Schedule check
sessionLifecycle.description: Check daily schedule and select module (Reality Orientation / Reminiscence / Exercise) based on time block and disease stage.

sessionLifecycle.name: Content preparation
sessionLifecycle.description: Load personalization profile and generate/select content.

sessionLifecycle.name: Instruction delivery
sessionLifecycle.description: Deliver one instruction at a time and capture patient response.

sessionLifecycle.name: Adaptive adjustment
sessionLifecycle.description: Adaptive difficulty controller adjusts the next item based on response and signals.

sessionLifecycle.name: Fatigue interrupt
sessionLifecycle.description: Engagement & fatigue monitor can interrupt at any point, pausing and logging the reason, with an option to resume later.

sessionLifecycle.name: Session close
sessionLifecycle.description: Log session, update progress trend, and optionally notify caregiver.

sharedContext: PatientProfile and stage setting shared with Exercise/ADL/Social agents for consistent difficulty calibration

crossAgentCalls.usage: Dual-Task Training exercises invoke this agent's cognitive-task generator as a component

successMetrics: Frequency of fatigue-triggered pauses (expected to decrease over time)
